india.one_line: Karnataka leads India's GCC and AI talent growth as startups secure funding and launch new platforms.

themes.title: Karnataka hosts over 1,000 global capability centres
themes.text: A new Zinnov-KDEM report shows Karnataka hosts over half of India's global capability centres and 111,000 AI and ML professionals.

stories.headline: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, new report finds

themes.title: Sarvam AI platform hosts Chinese models
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched its Token Factory platform hosting mostly Chinese models on domestic GPUs, prompting debate over sovereign AI despite receiving a government subsidy.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory hosts mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, sparking sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Startups raise funds for AI expansion
themes.text: Disseqt AI raised $8 million to expand its India hiring, and earth-intelligence startup SatSure secured ₹60 crore for its geospatial AI model.

stories.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8 million to expand enterprise AI governance platform
SatSure raises ₹60 Cr from Antariksh VC fund in Series B round

themes.title: Indian investors drive Anthropic trading rush
themes.text: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut generated heavy trading activity among Indian retail investors across platforms like INDmoney, Mudrex, and Vested.

stories.headline: Anthropic Nasdaq debut sparks buying rush among Indian retail investors
